title: Additional source evidence review

Additional source evidence review

Checked October 24, 2026. A read-only review assessed 1735 previously unpublished log, JSON and CSV files. No application was launched, edited, saved, or tested by this publication process.

Coverage and dispositions

The archive contains 132 original Markdown documents plus 1735 additional source files. Duplicate and empty files are accounted for rather than presented as new engineering milestones.

Method and limitations

Log excerpts select warnings, errors, exceptions, test/build outcomes, and ForgeMCP diagnostic messages. Each excerpt includes original line numbers and selected-line coverage. They consolidate repeated lines and omit telemetry. Files with no matching diagnostic signal remain listed in the review manifest. Byte-identical duplicates link to their canonical reading record where one exists.

JSON views preserve bounded technical structure or summarize large inventories. The CSV view reports parsed record counts, fields, and distributions. Historical inventory counts describe those source snapshots, not current website coverage or current acceptance. Local paths, credential-valued fields, embedded media, and authentication material are removed from public derivatives. No current operational readiness is inferred.

This review index is derived. Its SHA-256 refers to the downloadable review manifest, rather than an original Markdown source file.
